top_concerns: Only StreamingLLM and Quest are compared; closer token-level/compressed-key sparse decoding baselines (SparQ, Double Sparsity, Loki, MagicPIG, RetrievalAttention, ShadowKV, PQCache) are missing, so '8x higher sparsity than SOTA' is relative to Quest only
L1 distance on 2-bit codes is not justified (Eq. 3 covers only the unquantized rotation); no top-k/attention-mass recall analysis; thresholds, RoPE handling and dense layers unspecified

Narrow evaluation: two Llama-2-7B long-context models, six LongBench tasks, easy passkey, no GQA/larger models/RULER, no variance; 'matches full attention at 64 tokens' and 'lower perplexity than full attention' are overstated or unexplained

Efficiency evidence limited: one GPU, 4.4x only at kernel level, 1.5x end-to-end at 32K, implausible 'us' units in Table 2, Hadamard/bucketization overhead omitted, no latency comparison to Quest, estimation still O(s)
Hadamard ablation is a strawman (fixed thresholds on raw outlier-heavy activations) and novelty is moderate given QuaRot-style rotation and prior compressed-key estimation
